explication: Camunda 8 is a process-orchestration platform: users model and deploy BPMN processes, Zeebe executes them, human work can be completed in Tasklist, and operations and analytics are supported by Operate and Optimize. Identity provides integrated authentication and authorization. The repository also includes the Java/Spring client and cluster authentication, configuration, and search-schema subsystems. Edges between product capabilities follow README descriptions; sampled source shows Optimize ingestion and Zeebe state-query behavior. Other links are omitted where implementation wiring was not shown.
